subject: Localized demo scripts + pocket content pack for EMEA roadshow
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah O'Neil <hannah.oneil@brightspark.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Localized demo scripts + pocket content pack for EMEA roadshow

Team —

Quick ask to get content production moving for the EMEA roadshow series (dates: Apr 22–28, multiple cities). BrightSpark has confirmed the joint slot in London + Berlin; they want a local-friendly demo and a field-ready one-pager for reps. Need two parallel outputs:

1) Localized demo script pack (talk tracks + callouts) — variants: UK English, German, French. Keep the core demo flow identical but surface region-specific metrics and customer example snippets. Include an alternate shorter 3-minute "elevator" script for booth reps.

2) Pocket one-pager per market — single-sheet, visual, 150–200 words, clear CTA to schedule a deeper eval with us. Add a small compliance blurb for data residency where applicable (short sentence).

Timeline: draft 1 by EOD Apr 11 so we can get BrightSpark feedback on Apr 12. Final assets by Apr 16 for localization and audio recording.

I'm assigning primary writers to Marissa (scripts + slides) and Ava (one-pagers + localization vendor coordination). Sean — can you own voiceover / recorded demo segments and final export for the booth?

Please attach initial slide/script drafts when you reply. I'll sync with Hannah on any brand guardrails. Thanks — let's keep this lean.

Logan Wright
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah O'Neil <hannah.oneil@brightspark.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Localized demo scripts + pocket content pack for EMEA roadshow

Logan —

Attached: EMEA_demo_localized_v1.pptx (slide deck with UK/DE/FR script tabs) and pocket-guide-emea_onepager_v1.pdf (single-sheet comps). Quick notes: 

- Slide deck has the full demo flow (8 slides) and separate speaker notes for the 3-min elevator. I left placeholders where country metrics should be swapped (marked with <<COUNTRY_METRIC>>).
- Pocket one-pager is designed in two sizes: A5 and US-letter. Copy is intentionally concise.
- I flagged a couple of spots where BrightSpark branding assets will be required (logo, color palette) — Hannah, if you can send the guidelines we'll align visuals.

Outstanding items: German translation (copy only) and legal blurb confirmation for data residency — Ava can coordinate with the localization vendor. Sean, I included a "voiceover cue" column in the speaker notes for the audio segments.

Will iterate rapidly after you all review.

Attaching: EMEA_demo_localized_v1.pptx (pptx), pocket-guide-emea_onepager_v1.pdf (pdf)

—Marissa
Senior Content Strategist
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah O'Neil <hannah.oneil@brightspark.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:35:20 +0100
Subject: Re: Localized demo scripts + pocket content pack for EMEA roadshow

Thanks Marissa — this looks great. A couple of quick asks from BrightSpark side: 

- Could we move the customer success vignette to slide 4 (we use it early in our talks to set context)?
- We need a DE translation for the one-pager (German) and a short French pass — we can provide in-house review but would like Redwood to source the initial translation.
- Please add our standard brand/legal footer (I've attached the BrightSpark-brand-guidelines.pdf with the exact wording and logo files).

If you can share the editable deck (Google Slides link would be ideal) we'll annotate directly. We're on a tight timeline but can review the draft on Apr 12 morning.

On the logistics side, Marco Ruiz from our media partner (cc'd) will be on-site in Berlin and can coordinate booth AV (mics, playback). Marco — could you confirm you have the capability to play pre-recorded demo audio and run A/B cut playback for the booth?

Best,
Hannah
Director, Partnerships
BrightSpark Analytics

Confirmed: I can handle voiceover recording and will produce separate audio cuts for the full demo (approx. 6:30) and the 3-min elevator. Plan: record dry read by Apr 14, send MP3 + WAV for booth testing by Apr 16. I'll produce UK English and neutral EU English variants; for German/French we should use a native voice vendor — Ava, can you run the vendor brief?

Marco — can you confirm the booth playback specs (USB/SD player, codec support)? If you can play MP3 and WAV we're fine. Also will need a simple cue sheet for the tech operator.

I've attached recording-script-voiceover-notes.docx with timestamps and cue notes.

Thanks everyone — nice momentum. Quick checklist and owners so nothing slips: 

- Marissa: move customer vignette to slide 4 + upload editable Google Slides (due Apr 12 EOD).
- Ava: scope vendor brief for DE/FR translations and confirm pricing / TAT (due Apr 13 morning).
- Sean: record EU English dry read by Apr 14; confirm MP3/WAV will be delivered to Marco by Apr 16.
- Hannah/Marco: confirm playback specs and any AV constraints for London and Berlin booths by Apr 13.

Deliverables to hand to production on Apr 16: final slides (Google Slides link), localized one-pagers (DE/FR translations), voiceover audio files (MP3 + WAV), and a single ZIP with booth-ready assets.

I'll run a 30-min dry run on Apr 18 (recording + slide transitions) — calendar invite to follow. If there are any blockers flag them here and I'll escalate.

Thanks — feeling good about this.
